name: tinymvc/relay
description: A real-time relay for events, messages, and WebSocket broadcasts for TinyMVC / Spark framework.

suggest.ext-uv: Recommended for high-concurrency production deployments (removes the 1024 connection stream_select limit).
suggest.ext-ev: Alternative high-performance loop backend using libev/epoll.
suggest.ext-event: Alternative high-performance loop backend using libevent/epoll.
suggest.ext-pcntl: Required on Linux/Unix for graceful POSIX process signal handling (SIGTERM, SIGINT).
